{{Article header|section=Mining|deck=Community observations of materials reported across surveyed Planetary Mining Locations.}}

'''Surface Mining Prospecting''' records observations collected and contributed by '''CMDR Grumlop''' for use by EDFM. It is a reference for where materials were observed in the survey, not a list of official spawn or drop rules.

== Reading the observations ==

The observed percentage is the share of surveyed Planetary Mining Locations of a given ground type where that material was observed. For example, 29.8% means the material was observed in 34 of 114 surveyed locations of that ground type. The survey counts differ between ground types. A ground type not listed here was not recorded in this dataset; its absence does not show that the material is impossible there.
